title: Sorted Range Reporter
prompt: Implement `void sort_asc(int *a, int n)` (any in-place algorithm) and `int in_range(const int *sorted_a, int n, int lo, int hi)` counting elements of the ALREADY-SORTED array within [lo, hi] inclusive. For full credit, in_range should exploit sortedness with a scan that can stop early (or binary search twice) — but a correct linear scan also passes.
